source_name: data.gov.ua — реєстр наборів даних, що перебувають у володінні НБУ (каталожний запис)
why_relevant: A registry-of-registries listing every NBU-held dataset with id, name, formats and hyperlink — a compact machine-readable map of payment-card, terminal and payment-infrastructure datasets. Catalogued here (non-NBU infrastructure) rather than fetched from the NBU site, so no overlap with cell 01 collection.

source_name: ФГВФО — архів переліку банків-учасників Фонду
why_relevant: Dated historical snapshots of the member-bank list, which is exactly what is needed to reconstruct bank-population history without having to have been collecting snapshots yourself.

source_name: NBU — Statistics at the National Bank of Ukraine (methodology / statistical programme overview)
why_relevant: Describes what economic and financial data the NBU compiles, for what purpose, and which user groups it serves — a map of the whole statistical output, useful to enumerate datasets before collecting them.

source_name: Diia.Business — Ukrainian Fintech Catalog case page (state mirror of UAFIC research)
why_relevant: A government portal mirror/landing for the association's fintech market research, plus a separate Diia.Business entry describing EMA. Useful as a stable, fetch-friendly alternative route to association outputs when the association's own site is JS-heavy, and as evidence of which associations the state treats as official interlocutors.

source_name: regulation.gov.ua — каталог функцій та дозволів: «веде реєстр платіжних систем, систем розрахунків, учасників цих систем та операторів послуг платіжної інфраструктури»
why_relevant: State catalogue of regulatory functions and permits: it names, in official wording, which register each authority is legally obliged to maintain. An excellent meta-pointer for discovering registers that exist by law but are poorly surfaced on regulator websites.

source_name: Асоціація ЄМА — реєстр членів (member register)
why_relevant: Verified by fetch: roughly 80+ member logos covering banks (PrivatBank, Oschadbank, PUMB, Raiffeisen, OTP, Citi), schemes (Visa, Mastercard), processors and PSPs (Platon, NovaPay, EasyPay, iPay.ua), marketplaces (OLX, Prom.ua, Rozetka Pay) and even Moldovan banks (MAIB, Victoriabank). This is the single densest actor map of the Ukrainian cashless ecosystem.

source_name: YouControl — досьє компаній та джерела даних
why_relevant: Aggregates 180+ Ukrainian state sources into company dossiers (ownership, beneficiaries, connections, licences). Its public sources page is itself a pointer inventory — a shortcut to discovering registers this cell has not yet enumerated.

source_name: UkrCard — press and media appearances
why_relevant: Domestic processor that indexes its own executives' media interviews ('ми у ЗМІ'), including a Forbes Ukraine interview with card-market and transfer-volume detail. A compact map of where processor executives speak and what numbers they release.

source_name: Company-registry aggregators (YouControl / Opendatabot / SMIDA) for vendor legal entities
why_relevant: Every vendor in this cell has a Ukrainian legal entity with EDRPOU code, filed financials, beneficial owners and, often, public-procurement history. This converts marketing claims into auditable revenue and ownership data — the quantitative backbone for sizing the bank-tech supply market.

source_name: НАБУ — Банки-учасники (member bank register)
why_relevant: Explicit member register of the largest banking association — the cheapest structured map of which banks are active and organised in Ukraine, and a seed list for per-bank scouting (annual reports, ATM/POS fleet disclosures).

source_name: НАБУ — Асоційовані члени (associate members: vendors, processors, IT)
why_relevant: Associate-member lists of banking associations typically contain the technology vendors, processors, ATM/POS suppliers and consultancies serving the banks — exactly the competitor/partner ecosystem map for a payments-hardware and services player.

source_name: Prozorro Infobox — procurement knowledge base
why_relevant: Official explanatory base for how Prozorro procedures, e-catalogues, analytics modules and monitoring work. Essential for correctly interpreting tender statuses, procedure types and data fields before drawing market conclusions, and a rich source of further terminology and portal pointers.

source_name: Ukrainian Processing Centre (UPC) — Clients page
why_relevant: UPC is Ukraine's largest third-party card processor (Raiffeisen Bank International group). Its clients page is a reference-customer list naming banks and PSPs it processes for, which maps issuing/acquiring relationships that are otherwise unpublished, and snowballs into further bank actors.

source_name: Wikipedia (uk) — ПРОСТІР (платіжна система)
why_relevant: Not a citable statistic source, but an efficient entry point to the PROSTIR actor map: predecessor names (НСМЕП), participant counts, co-badging history and a footnote trail into NBU documents and older regulations.

source_name: DoZorro — civic monitoring portal and analytics toolbox
why_relevant: Transparency International Ukraine's monitoring layer over Prozorro. Aggregates analytical tools, risk indicators and feedback on specific tenders; a strong pointer to other analytics platforms and to contested/high-value contracts worth reading in full.

source_name: EU capacity4dev Ukraine library
why_relevant: Repository of EU programme documents and evaluations for Ukraine; a snowball route to EU-funded financial-sector and digitalisation technical assistance reports not indexed elsewhere.

source_name: MarketResearch.com — Ukraine banking/payments report catalogue
why_relevant: Second major report reseller; cross-checking its Ukraine catalogue against ResearchAndMarkets surfaces publishers that list on only one platform (e.g. Mordor Intelligence electronic-payments series), improving completeness of the commercial-publisher map.

source_name: PC Week/UE — Banking IT Summit (Банківський ІТ САМІТ)
why_relevant: The main Ukrainian bank-IT conference: its sponsor lists, speaker rosters and agendas are a compact annual census of which vendors and integrators are actively selling into Ukrainian banks, plus the topics banks are buying. Classic pointer source that snowballs into vendors invisible to search.

source_name: ResearchAndMarkets — Ukraine Cards and Payments 2026 (report reseller listing)
why_relevant: Aggregator/reseller that lists Ukraine payment- and card-market reports from many publishers (GlobalData, Euromonitor, others). Its catalogue is the fastest way to enumerate which commercial houses actually cover Ukraine payments and how often they refresh; listings carry free scope/TOC text with segment definitions.

source_name: Ukraine Donor Platform (G7/IFI coordination, project & support matrices)
why_relevant: Central coordination hub listing which IFI/donor (WB, IFC, EBRD, EIB, CEB, IMF, OECD) is doing what in Ukraine's private and financial sector — an efficient snowball point into individual programme documents.

source_name: Ukrainian Sociological Portal — directory of research organisations (Дослідницькі організації)
why_relevant: Curated directory enumerating Ukrainian research and survey organisations — the cheapest way to complete the local research-house actor map beyond the handful of well-known names and to find niche agencies that may run financial-services panels.

source_name: Українська Асоціація Маркетингу (УАМ / Ukrainian Marketing Association)
why_relevant: Professional association with collective and individual members whose core activity is market research and public-opinion polling. Relevant as a pointer to the Ukrainian research-agency supply side (who can field a consumer payments survey) and occasionally as a publisher of consumer-behaviour data touching payment methods.
